description.value: Spoke Haven is a full-service bicycle shop in Squamish offering tune-ups, repairs, upgrades, and sales from a compact but fully stocked workshop with skilled mechanics. The shop primarily schedules appointments but also welcomes drop-in customers for expert advice, tuning tips, and mechanical work as time permits. Located on Government Road, it is a practical mechanical resource for cyclists traveling the Sea-to-Sky corridor.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Primary evidence is the website content for spokehaven.ca, which confirms address, phone, email, and services. The OSM record provides only name and shop=bicycle tags with no contact details, so the website is the authoritative source for all contact fields. The website explicitly describes an active workshop with mechanics, bike tune-ups, and repairs, and contains contradictory statements about walk-ins (both 'appointment-only, no walk-ins' and 'we happily welcome walk-ins on a first-come, first-served basis'), which is flagged as a concern.
concerns: OSM name is 'Spoke Haven' but website uses 'Spoke Haven Bike Shop' — minor name discrepancy.

Website contains contradictory walk-in policy: one passage says 'appointment-only (no walk-ins)' while another says 'we happily welcome walk-ins on a first-come, first-served basis' — may confuse visiting cyclists.
OSM record has no address, phone, or email tags; all contact data sourced from website only.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active, full-service bike shop in Squamish with skilled mechanics and walk-in access — a clear and valuable resource for touring cyclists on the Sea-to-Sky route.

Staff help with urgent mechanical issues.detail: we happily welcome walk-ins on a first-come, first-served basis

Walk-in repairs.detail: While we mainly work by appointment, we happily welcome walk-ins on a first-come, first-served basis. Feel free to drop by anytime!
